what_are_incarnons: Incarnon weapons are old, weak weapons given a second life. Installing an Incarnon Genesis adapter adds an evolution tree to the weapon.

Once installed, landing hits charges the Incarnon Transmutation gauge under your reticle. Press Alt-Fire to transmute: the weapon transforms into its Incarnon Form with massively boosted damage, crit, status, and a new firing behavior.

Evolving the weapon requires completing challenges (solo missions, Incarnon kills, headshots, etc.). Each evolution offers perk choices — pick one per evolution; choices are free to change later at Cavalero or in the arsenal.
The adapter is installed on ONE variant — install it on the best variant you own (Prime > Vandal/Wraith > base). Prime variants keep their superior base stats under the Incarnon bonuses.
evolution_stages: Evolution I — unlocks on install. Grants the Incarnon Form itself and defines how it charges (e.g. direct hits, headshots, combo count).
Evolution II — challenge: complete a solo mission with the weapon equipped. Two stat perks: usually +damage with a conditional bonus. Pick the bigger flat number.

Evolution III — challenge varies (e.g. activate Incarnon Form several times in one mission, or get Incarnon kills). Three perks shaping the Incarnon Form — fire rate, projectile speed, magazine, range.

Evolution IV — challenge varies (e.g. headshot kills, finishers, heavy-attack kills). Three perks defining the Incarnon Form's identity — crit chance, status chance, or special effects. This is the most build-defining pick.
guide.install_cost: Adapters install at Cavalero in the Chrysalith: 20 Pathos Clamps + two types of Duviri resources (e.g. Yao Shrubs, Lamentus, Rune Marrow, Maw Fangs, Eevani, Tasoma Extract, Kovnik). Farm Pathos Clamps from the Circuit and Duviri resource nodes.

sources.name: Steel Path Circuit (The Duviri Paradox)
sources.how: Complete The Duviri Paradox and unlock Steel Path, then run the Circuit. Each week offers 5 adapters (fixed 9-week rotation); pick ONE at Tier 5 and a SECOND at Tier 10 — 2 adapters per week max. Tier 5 = 12 stages, Tier 10 = ~34 stages.
sources.note: Slow but free. At 2/week, collecting all 45 takes ~23 weeks of Circuit.

sources.name: Cavalero's Incarnon Market (platinum shortcut)
sources.how: 10 adapters (Boar, Gammacor, Anku, Gorgon, Angstrum, Dera, Sybaris, Cestra, Sicarus, Okina) can be bought from Cavalero for 120 platinum during that adapter's live week. Includes the install resources. One-time purchase each.
sources.note: Best used to skip weeks for meta picks or finish your collection.

sources.name: Zariman Incarnons (Holdfasts)
sources.how: The 5 original Incarnon weapons — Laetum, Phenmor, Felarx, Innodem, Praedos — are bought as blueprints from Cavalero with Holdfasts standing (MR14). They evolve through their own challenges, no adapter needed.
sources.note: Laetum (pistol) and Phenmor (rifle) are still S-tier to this day.

sources.name: Albrecht's Incarnons (Cavia)
sources.how: A second batch of inherent Incarnon weapons drops from Disruption Armatus on Deimos (rotation reward) or can be bought from Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica for Vessel Capillaries.
sources.note: Requires Whispers in the Walls completion.

tier_notes.S: Worth grinding the Circuit for. These compete with or beat the best non-Incarnon weapons in the game.
tier_notes.A: Strong and fun — grab them when their week comes up, especially if you own the Prime variant.
tier_notes.B: Completionist picks. Fun Incarnon modes, but outclassed — get them last.

weapons.why: Braton Prime was already good; the Incarnon turns it into one of the best automatic rifles in the game. Cheap to build, amazing all-rounder.

evolutions.desc: Unlocks the Incarnon Form: land direct hits to charge, Alt-Fire to transmute into the rapid-fire mode.

evolutions.challenge: Complete a solo mission with this weapon equipped.
options: +Damage with a conditional bonus (e.g. on headshot kill)
evolutions.pick: Take the flat +damage option — conditionals rarely beat raw damage on a bullet hose.

evolutions.challenge: Weapon-specific mission challenge (e.g. activate Incarnon Form multiple times in one mission).
evolutions.pick: Fire rate — the Incarnon Form scales hardest with fire rate and multishot.

evolutions.challenge: Weapon-specific combat challenge (shown in the arsenal when installed).
evolutions.pick: Critical chance — pushes the Incarnon Form into red-crit territory with Critical Delay.
